name: jm-income-tax
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Jamaica personal income tax for self-employed individuals or employees with additional income. Trigger on phrases like "how much tax do I pay in Jamaica", "S04 return", "IT01 return", "chargeable income", "tax-free threshold", "NIS contributions", "NHT contributions", "Education Tax", "HEART levy", "PAYE Jamaica", "self-employed tax Jamaica", "TAJ filing", "statutory deductions Jamaica", or any question about filing or computing income tax for a self-employed person or an employee with other income sources in Jamaica. Also trigger when computing payroll deductions, quarterly estimated tax (S04A), NIS ceiling, NHT contributions, Education Tax, or capital allowances for a Jamaican taxpayer.
